overloadMerges.note: Fixed directions per the parameter table's arrow column: operationNum is read on input (last operation already integrated) and overwritten on output (new last-integrated operation number), so it is 'inout'; errObject is filled by the command, so it is 'out'.

params.name: pathName
params.description: Absolute or relative (to the database folder) path of the log file to integrate; pass an empty string to display an Open File dialog.

params.name: operationNum
params.description: In: number of the last operation already integrated (integration resumes at the next operation), or -2 to integrate the whole file. Out: updated to the number of the last operation integrated, for reuse in a subsequent call.

sentinelValues.meaning: Integrate all operations in the log file.
Strict mode (default): integration stops at the first error.
Auto repair mode: non-critical errors are bypassed and auto-repaired; each is logged into errObject if passed.

params.name: errObject
params.description: Filled with an "operations" array describing every record auto-repaired during integration (only meaningful in auto repair mode).

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Integrates a 4D Server mirror log file into the database starting after a given operation number, continuing to use the current log file afterward rather than replacing it.

constraints: Can only be executed on 4D Server, via the Execute on server command or from a stored procedure.

Unlike the legacy _o_INTEGRATE LOG FILE command, this command does not replace the current log file with the integrated one; the database's current log file continues to be used, and any changes made during integration are appended to it.
Since operationNum became a required parameter (versions after v15 R4), pass -2 explicitly to restore the old default behavior of integrating the whole file.
